overview_description.description:
Alfie is a private equity and venture capital firm that specializes in providing creative solutions for individuals looking to purchase or refinance a variety of real estate investments. It offers a loan that are collateral-based for transactions of $150,000+*. Terms are flexible, with three months to two years for repayment.

The company was founded in 2017 and headquartered in Asheville	North Carolina.
